conversation:
matt: Orbitel wants to kick off a 2-week POC next month. Security sent an identity checklist — need to align before SOW.
ivy: Summary of asks: non-human service accounts w/ rotation, SCIM delta semantics & rate limits, tenant domain proofing + tenant lock, delegated admin RBAC, SAML sample for Okta, and cert rotation cadence (they prefer <=45d). Also they asked whether Dedicated is possible for the POC and what that costs.
priya: Service accounts: we support scoped API keys and short-lived JWTs. If they require HSM signing we can wire to their KMS (customer-managed) for JWT rotation. Rotation cadence: monthly by default, can do shorter with Private.
leo: SCIM: delta sync supported. Default delta retention = 30d. Rate limits: 100 requests/min per tenant on delta endpoints; for >2k users recommend bulk CSV/SCIM bulk import. We can provide backoff guidance.
matt: Domain proofing options?
ivy: TXT or CNAME verification. Tenant lock requires an org-admin verification step + 7d token TTL. Auto-renew DNS is available for Private/Dedicated (DNS automation).
priya: RBAC: roles scoped at org/team/model. Delegated admin role = manage_users + assign_roles. For a POC we can create a temporary delegated admin user limited to their dev seats and expire after the POC.
matt: Can someone paste a minimal SAML SP metadata snippet for their Okta team to configure ACS/SLO?
leo: Pasting minimal snippet:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://orbitel.example.com">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Notes: NameID=email, audience = client_id. They should enable WantAssertionsSigned=true on Okta side if they sign assertions.
ivy: Pricing: Dedicated 1x A10G-equivalent pool pro-rated for 1 month is our typical approach for short POCs. Ballpark for region-us-west: ~$16k pro-rated for a 2-week window (finance to confirm). Hosted + VPC peering is cheaper and faster to stand up if they balk on budget.
matt: Cert rotation: they want <=45d for mTLS. Feasible?
priya: 45d for managed Hosted/Dedicated is tight; our managed certs default to 90d. We can support 45d only if Orbitel provides ACME/automation (Private) or we put them on Private with customer ACME. We'll call that out as a hard requirement.
matt: Security questionnaire items flagged: KMS integration, audit log retention & access, pen test report, breach notification SLA. Who will draft replies?
ivy: I'll own KMS + audit logs + pen test uploads. @priya handle breach notification & legal SLA contacts.
priya: Will draft responses and attach docs by EOD tomorrow.
leo: Ops note: if Orbitel insists on Dedicated, provisioning lead time is ~5 business days for an isolated pool. Hosted + regional routing can be done in ~24-48h.
matt: Deliverables for Orbitel POC package: 1) SAML sample + SCIM rate/retention doc, 2) temp delegated admin account, 3) pricing options (Dedicated pro-rate vs Hosted fallback), 4) completed security questionnaire + attachments, 5) cert rotation runbook with Private/Dedicated tradeoffs.
